editorial:
Imagine loving someone from a distance for years, only to find out they are dating someone else in secret. That is exactly what happens to Ai, a girl who is completely obsessed with her classmate Tatoe. Instead of just feeling sad, she decides to take a darker path. She starts messing with Tatoe's life and tries to break up the couple so she can have him for herself. The whole vibe is a mix of a sweet high school crush and a creepy psychological game. You will feel for Ai at first, but then you start to wonder if she has gone way too far.

The acting is the best part here because the emotions feel very real and raw. The pacing is steady, though some parts might feel a bit slow if you want a fast thriller. One downside is that some of the character choices are frustrating, but that is part of the drama. If you like stories about obsession and secret love, you should definitely check this out. It looks great in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, but if you are a movie collector, adding the 4K Blu-ray to your physical collection is the way to go for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: In the final scenes, Ai's plan to steal Tatoe fails. She realizes that her obsession was more about her own loneliness than actual love. The movie wraps up with Ai finally letting go of her crush and accepting that she cannot force someone to love her. It is a sad but necessary ending where she chooses to stop hurting others and starts to heal herself, leaving Tatoe and his girlfriend alone.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves complex romance and character studies.
